settings.onlyYou: Everything on this page is yours only and is saved on your PC. It changes nothing on the server, for players or for other staff.

language.text: The language of this panel and every script's screens for you. It changes at once for this session; to keep it next time use the w_lib settings button.
language.example: Pick English and every text turns English, left to right

languageDialog.text: Closes the panel and opens the w_lib settings, where your language choice is saved for good. Nobody else is affected.
languageDialog.undo: Yes, open it again and pick another language

density.text: Changes the row height of tables. Comfortable reads easier; Compact fits more rows on the screen.
density.example: Compact shows about 20 players instead of 16 on the same screen

tableMode.text: Picks the columns of the Players and Characters tables together: Essential for the important ones only, Detailed adds cash, gold, health, gang and license.

motion.text: Turns off movement and transitions in the panel. Useful if motion bothers you or the PC is slow; nothing else changes.

helpMode.text: Makes every ? in the panel stand out; press any ? to learn what the thing beside it does. Shortcut F1; your choice is remembered.
helpMode.undo: Yes, turn it off here or with F1

settings.preview: A live sample of how tables look with your settings. Change the row size or the columns and watch it change here.

reset.text: Puts all your own panel settings back to how they came: row size, columns, motion and help mode. The server and players are not touched.

settings.account: Your staff account as the server sees it. Your level decides which pages and buttons you can use.
settings.accName: Your account name on the server, shown in the admin log next to everything you do.
settings.accLevel: Your staff level: mod, then admin, then god; each level can do everything below it. Only the owner can change it.
settings.accCid: The fixed citizen ID of your current character. Type it into any player box to pick yourself.
settings.accSession: Your session number (#) for this visit. It changes every time you join, which is why we use the citizen ID.
settings.openPerms: Opens the Permissions page showing what each level can do. Read only; it changes nothing.
settings.keys: Keyboard shortcuts. They work while the panel is open. From the game, F10 also opens the panel and PgUp the quick menu.

settings.onlyYou: These settings are yours only and are saved on your PC.
settings.languageDesc: Every script's screens follow it for you in this session.
settings.densityDesc: The row height in every table.
settings.tableModeDesc: How many columns the Players and Characters tables show.
settings.helpModeDesc: Every ? stands out and explains what is beside it.
settings.resetDone: Your settings are back to how they came

key.close: Close the panel or a window
